name: Satomi Ritsuko
source: Ritsuko is a press photographer who has a dominating personality. She was the first survivor to meet Ayame Ito. Ritsuko exchanges text messages with her fiancé, Masami Yoshinaka, who works at the Amare Patriarcha Crucis hospital, while dreaming of being reunited. She persuades the others survivors to gather and barricade themselves at the nurse's station, however...
